correctness.rationale: For endpoint-anchored binary words, P(z)P(z^-1) is exactly the two-sided autocorrelation generating Laurent polynomial, and D=2^(L-1)P(2)P(1/2) is just one evaluation. Direct bit arithmetic gives A=1100125 and B=1269125, reverse integers 1528417 and 1324889 and common product 1681449752125; populations 10 and 11 differ. Independently reconstructed the COMPLETE exact enumeration over all 2^(L-2) anchored words modulo reversal for each 2<=L<=21; no deficient product fiber until L=21 and exactly one exceptional product fiber (with two reversal classes) at L=21 among 262231 distinct products. Reversal preserves D and correlation, so enumeration does not omit candidate collisions. The theorem is only a finite equal-span statement, not a higher-length or unequal-span classification.
